name: Moralis
tagline: Enterprise Web3 data APIs for wallets, tokens, NFTs, and blockchain activity across major chains
description: Moralis provides REST APIs that return indexed blockchain data for EVM chains and others, covering wallet balances and transfers, token and NFT metadata, prices, DeFi positions, and transaction history. Developers authenticate with an API key, call versioned endpoints, and use the data for portfolio apps, analytics, compliance tooling, and Web3 backends without running their own indexers.

auth.details: API key via X-API-Key header (also accepted as query param apiKey on some endpoints); self-serve signup at Moralis admin

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free plan with limited CU/month (confirm on pricing page; historically starter free tier with compute units)
pricing.paid_plans: Paid plans by compute units (CU) and throughput; see moralis.io/pricing

rate_limits: Plan-based throughput and monthly CU; exact numbers depend on plan (not fully verified here)
use_cases: get native balance for a wallet address
list ERC-20 token balances for a wallet
fetch NFT ownership and metadata for an address
get token price by contract address
query wallet transaction history across chains
resolve token or NFT metadata by contract and token id
